# OULA Repo-wide Copilot Instructions — Exhibition Release
This is the **real product source**. Lovable = independent simulation only; do not touch or import from Lovable without an explicit scoped review. ROS is a wholly separate project. Read `AGENTS.md`, `docs/delivery/EXPO_2026_RELEASE_TRAIN.md`, and `contracts/openapi.yaml` before modifying code.
Backend is authoritative Java21 Spring Boot4/Spring Modulith 2, PostgreSQL16/PostGIS, Flyway migrations V001–V020 plus future additions; `mvn -B -ntp verify` CI must pass. Real frontend is `apps/web` in this SAME repository; strict TS and responsive Arabic RTL English LTR.
Only owner of a canonical bounded context mutates its data. Person != User; Property != Listing != Building; Provenance VERIFIED != DECLARED != ESTIMATED != AI_INFERRED. Recommendation != Decision != Action; observed outcomes are not causal claims. All sensitive operations require workspace+purpose+scope and authorization; idempotency/outbox/audit where applicable.
No live government, banking, registry, payment, escrow, external lease signing or IoT integration unless authorized and tested. DEMO/SANDBOX marked truthfully.
Branch per issue. PR + cross-stack contract checks required; do not push directly to main, disable tests, modify other agents' domains, or provision paid cloud. No production go-live before founder's later VS Code deployment stage.
